title: MIA40 is an oxidoreductase that catalyzes oxidative protein folding in mitochondria.
experiment: 15N backbone longitudinal (R1) and transverse (R2) spin relaxation and heteronuclear 15N{1H} NOE at 500 MHz and 600 MHz (15N{1H} NOE plotted at 600 MHz in Fig. 4b)
buffer: 50 mM phosphate buffer containing 10% (v/v) D2O, plus 2 mM DTT
construct_or_mutation: recombinant full-length human MIA40 (142 residues) in reduced-CPC state MIA402S-S (Cys53-Cys55 reduced; Cys64-Cys97 and Cys74-Cys87 disulfides oxidized)
other_conditions: 0.5-1 mM 15N-labeled MIA402S-S; monomeric in vitro (confirmed by static multiangle light scattering); overall molecule tumbling correlation time tm = 10.6 ± 0.5 ns; reliable relaxation values not obtained for residues 109-118 due to NH cross-peak overlap
author_claim: Regions 1-41 and 107-142 at the N and C termini (~80% of full-length 142-residue MIA40 outside the structured central domain) lack secondary structure and are highly flexible, showing R2/R1 ratios below those of the alpha-helical regions and negative or low (<0.5) 15N{1H} NOE values, whereas the N-terminal lid (residues 41-64, including helix alpha1 56-59) and CX9C alpha-hairpin core (helices alpha2 65-77 and alpha3 88-100) have R2/R1 and 15N{1H} NOE values consistent with a rigid structured conformation.
anchor: MIA402S-S residue number collected at 600 MHz in 50 mM phosphate
locator: Results p. 199, Fig. 4b and legend p. 201, and Methods (NMR spectroscopy) pp. 204-205
caveat_note: Deposit comparison: the RelaxDB entry card for MIA40 lists sequence_length = 66 (matching the 66-residue folded central domain in PDB 2K3J, Abstract p. 198), sheet_temperature_K = 298.5, sheet_field_MHz = 600, and blank bmrb_id/sample components, whereas all NMR experiments in this paper were collected at 298 K on full-length 142-residue human MIA40 (BMRB 15763); whether the RelaxDB entry represents the 66-residue folded subset sliced from this 600 MHz full-length dataset cannot be confirmed from paper.txt alone. Minor internal pH formatting difference: Methods (p. 204) states pH 7.0 while Fig. 4b legend (p. 201) prints pH 7. Per-residue 15N{1H} NOE values are plotted graphically in Fig. 4b, and R2/R1 plots are in Supplementary Fig. 1 online (not attached; no PMCID). Single-letter codes for terminal endpoints 1, 107, and 142 are not printed in paper.txt.

experiment: 2D 1H-15N HSQC at 800 MHz (comparison of reduced-CPC MIA402S-S with fully oxidized MIA403S-S)
buffer: 50 mM phosphate buffer containing 10% (v/v) D2O, plus 2 mM DTT
construct_or_mutation: recombinant full-length human MIA40 (142 residues) in reduced-CPC state MIA402S-S (Cys53-Pro54-Cys55 dithiol; Cys64-Cys97 and Cys74-Cys87 disulfides oxidized)
other_conditions: 0.5-1 mM 13C,15N- or 15N-labeled MIA402S-S; monomeric in vitro; in the solution NMR ensemble of MIA402S-S (PDB 2K3J), Pro54 and Cys55 show alpha-helical propensity (~40% of conformers); reduction of Cys53-Cys55 causes local 1H and 15N chemical shift changes restricted to lid segment 50-64 (including G41, W51, N52, C53, L56, G57, G58, G62 labeled in Fig. 2b), with no core CX9C chemical shift changes even up to 100 mM DTT
author_claim: Disappearance of the backbone NH signal of catalytic Cys55 in 1H-15N HSQC spectra of MIA402S-S (together with partial ~40% alpha-helical propensity at Pro54 and Cys55 in the NMR ensemble) indicates local structural flexibility in the reduced CPC active-site motif, while chemical shift perturbations between MIA402S-S and MIA403S-S remain localized to segment 50-64.

title: MIA40 is an oxidoreductase that catalyzes oxidative protein folding in mitochondria.
experiment: 2D 1H-15N HSQC at 800 MHz and 1H/13C/15N chemical shift index (CSI) analysis on fully oxidized MIA403S-S
buffer: 50 mM phosphate buffer containing 10% (v/v) D2O (no DTT)
construct_or_mutation: recombinant full-length human MIA40 (142 residues) in fully oxidized state MIA403S-S (Cys53-Cys55, Cys64-Cys97, and Cys74-Cys87 disulfides oxidized)
other_conditions: 0.5-1 mM 13C,15N- or 15N-labeled MIA403S-S purified in aerobic conditions; CSI indicates helices at 56-59 (alpha1), 65-77 (alpha2), and 88-100 (alpha3), while ~80% of residues at the N and C termini lack secondary structure
author_claim: In contrast to reduced MIA402S-S where the Cys55 NH resonance disappears, the backbone NH signal of Cys55 remains detectable in fully oxidized MIA403S-S, indicating increased local structural rigidity in the CPC region upon Cys53-Cys55 disulfide-bond formation.

locator: Results pp. 199-200, Fig. 2b and legend p. 200; conditions: Methods pp. 204-205
caveat_note: Recorded at 800 MHz on fully oxidized 142-residue MIA403S-S without DTT (whereas r1 and r2 use reduced-CPC MIA402S-S with 2 mM DTT, and the RelaxDB card lists 600 MHz, 298.5 K, sequence_length = 66).
